name: Collegno (Italy)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Collegno within olive and oak branches, and the inscription CITTÀ DI COLLEGNO in yellow beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Collegno, a comune in Piedmont; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Collegno arms — crowned shield within branches
inscription CITTÀ DI COLLEGNO beneath the arms
